🎤

Do a set

You perform — so let's get you on a Kraków stage.

Harry might do one set during our stay… he's thinking about it. The main English scene is Kraków Standup Comedy (@krakowstandupcomedy) — message them for an open-mic slot, and check their Facebook page, a good way to find other shows and venues. You've also got a friend who may be able to point you to an alternative show or venue. Sign up early; slots go fast.
🎻

A klezmer night

On Szeroka — steps from the flat.

Harry's always wanted to see a live klezmer show — and Szeroka, right outside the flat, has it every night at 8pm. The place to finally do it.

The big Jewish Culture Festival ("Shalom on Szeroka") is late June / early July — not your dates — so these nightly restaurant concerts are the way to hear klezmer in August.

🌾

Gluten-free options

Just in case you need them.

Just in case: these are spots that list themselves as gluten-free (several are certified) — handy to have in your back pocket rather than a must-do. Worth adding to the FindMeGlutenFree app for Kraków, which maps live reviews across the city.
GF drinks — good news: distilled vodka is gluten-free (and Polish potato vodkas like Luksusowa, Chopin & Vestal are naturally so), cider is GF, and dedicated gluten-free beer is poured at House of Beer, Zapiekane and Strefa Piwa — so the drinks below are fair game, just skip grain beer.

Menus & suppliers change — always say you're coeliac and confirm at the table.

🍸

Possible drinks & vodka options

A tasting, and somewhere for a GF beer.

Harry fancies a proper vodka tasting — and a beer now and then, so a spot with gluten-free beer on tap is good to know about.

On during your stay

9–16 Aug 2026 — what's actually happening.

Just FYI — we don't have to go to any of these. They're simply happening while we're in town, so nice to know they're an option.
12–16 Aug

🥟 Pierogi Festival

The dumpling contest takes over Mały Rynek (10:00 till the last visitor; awards 14 Aug) — hundreds of varieties, big buzz. Mostly wheat, so hunt the GF stalls, but a proper atmosphere.

Festival page ↗
through Aug

🎷 Summer Jazz Festival

Poland's biggest jazz fest runs all summer (~150 concerts), centred on the legendary Piwnica pod Baranami. Perfect for a spontaneous late night.

summerjazz.pl ↗
10–16 Aug

🎬 Green Film Festival

Lands right in your window — the Festival Village sits on the Vistula embankments at the foot of Wawel, with screenings, workshops and riverside events.

greenfestival.pl ↗
Sun 9 Aug

🎶 Summer Arts finale

Your arrival day catches the tail of the Summer Arts Festival — an evening riverside gala concert. A gentle first night.
